settings.ggXEpr5-fkx_text: Why dental care is vital for your dog!
settings.ggCsdNBmGYV_text: Brushing can be stressful, but without daily cleaning, teeth become discolored, tartar builds up, and bacteria cause bad breath. Veterinarians call it gingivitis. If left untreated, bacteria from infected gums enters the bloodstream and can damage heart, liver, and kidneys, leading to risk of tooth loss and jaw bone damage.
settings.ggWT-9oyucQ_childItem_0: Studies show untreated dental disease shortens lifespan for pets by 2-5 years
settings.ggRLsa-Jnvo_text: All this is easily preventable but requires action today!

settings.gghOsiLQW5A_text: The problem isn't that dental care is hard - it's that traditional methods don't work for most dogs
settings.ggawz35J_oS_text: FreshWipes change everything. Instead of fighting with a toothbrush, you simply slip the textured wipe over your finger and gently clean their teeth. Most dogs accept it immediately - some even enjoy it!
